newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank aims for 11 pct ROE in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank aims for 11 pct ROE in 1998.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG said on Wednesday it plans to raise its return on equity after tax to 11 percent in 1998 from 8.6 percent in 1996.
The bank also said it planned to reduce its cost-income ratio below 60 percent in the next two years from the 1996 level of 62.4 percent.

Chief executive Albrecht Schmidt said the bank also aimed to strengthen its position in the market for real estate finance and planned to increase its share of the market for private residential construction finance to 15 percent from six percent. He did not specify a time period.
Schmidt did not say in the text of his speech what Vereinsbank's forecast is for the 1997 return on equity and cost-income ratio.
He added that Vereinsbank sees itself as a "bank of regions" and prefers to have a high market penetration in selected areas rather than an average market share everywhere.
Schmidt said Vereinsbank was benefiting from its decentralised, regional market presence. Vereinsbank is based in Munich and has a Hamburg-based subsidiary, Vereins- und Westbank AG.
